ValidationRule.description: Cannot set the status to deposit return without entering the deposit return details
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType.DeveloperName = "Deposit" && ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Deposit Returned") && (ISBLANK( Deposit_Amount_Returned__c ) || ISBLANK( Deposit_Returned_Date__c ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Deposit Amount Returned and Deposit Returned Date
